title: Labor-market matching (minimum wage)
description: Horton-style labor-market replication. 30 employers and 60 workers; a minimum-wage floor binds at tick 25. Watch unemployment, posted wage, and accepted offers shift.
attribution: Inspired by Horton 2023 'Large language models as simulated economic agents'.

classes.name: Employer
classes.proseIdentity: An employer with a private productivity-per-worker value. Posts a wage, accepts/rejects applicants. Mildly noisy; cuts hours when costs bind.

classes.name: Worker
classes.proseIdentity: A worker with a private reservation wage. Searches, applies, accepts above reservation. Some have outside options.

payload.text: City council enacts a minimum wage of 0.55. Employers posting below must adjust.

readmeMd:
# Labor-market matching

Minimum wage binds at tick 25. The interesting moment is the gap between tick 24 and tick 30: who exits, who adjusts.
